1.explanation:
• DatePicker/DatePicker.mdx: official usage and API reference for the DatePicker component (shows datePickerType options).  
• DatePicker/migrate-to-7.x.md: notes on breaking changes around date picker behavior introduced in recent major versions, to track regressions post-Carbon 11.  
• DatePicker/next/DatePicker.mdx: upcoming or experimental implementation details for single‐mode handling (to compare new vs. current code paths).  
• DatePicker/plugins/: contains the internal plugin code that wires up “start”/“end” inputs and event listeners—critical for diagnosing why start is not a valid element.  
• DatePickerInput/next/DatePickerInput.mdx: docs for the paired input component (ensures correct prop usage in single mode).
1.bug_scenario:
The bug occurs when rendering the Carbon DatePicker component in “single” mode (datePickerType="single"). On load (Safari, @carbon/react v1.2.0) the component throws a TypeError in DatePicker.js at the line where it calls start.addEventListener(…) because the variable “start” is not a DOM element. In the supplied screenshot you can see the app’s form UI (Carbon theme), but the DatePicker never appears and the console is cleared (no rendered output) due to the crash. This happens immediately when you include datePickerType="single" on the <DatePicker>.

Key elements in the scenario:
- The DatePicker wrapper (dark-themed background)
- The single-mode DatePickerInput (mm/dd/yyyy placeholder)
- The TypeError in the console referencing start.addEventListener
